calibration_source: R26 historical B confirmed-normal scores only
label_availability: R26 retrospective assumption retained; actual original annotation arrival time unknown
np_formula: smallest k with binom.sf(k-1,n,1-alpha)<=delta; strict score > Z_(k)
preservation: For OR rules, old alerts are immutable. Calibration scores for old alerts are +infinity; infinite order statistic is infeasible, never zero-alert success.
guarantee_scope: Fixed scores and independent identically distributed normal calibration/deployment draws. Does not guarantee every finite future cell or distribution-shifted data.
coverage_reason: Candidate chosen after already-opened R26 results; no post-selection 95% certificate is claimed. This is a fixed-rule development audit.
selection: No alpha, delta, model, seed, or threshold search on B/D evaluation labels
